from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 16(ia): old regime standard deduction limit
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')  # Sec 115BAC / Sec 16(ia): new regime standard deduction limit

# Sec 24(b) / Sec 71(3A) - Self-occupied house property interest cap (old regime)
SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal('200000')  # Sec 24(b): max interest deduction for self-occupied house

# Sec 80CCE / Sec 80C - Chapter VI-A investment limits (old regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal('150000')  # Sec 80C: max aggregate deduction for investments

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution limit (old regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80CCD(1B): max additional NPS deduction

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits (old regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_BASE = Decimal('25000')     # Sec 80D(i): limit for self/family below senior age
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')   # Sec 80D(i): limit for self/family if senior citizen
SEC_80D_PARENTS_BASE = Decimal('25000')  # Sec 80D(ii): limit for parents below senior age
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')# Sec 80D(ii): limit for parents if senior citizen

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and maximums
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal('500000')     # Sec 87A: old regime total income rebate threshold
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal('12500')        # Sec 87A: old regime max rebate
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal('1200000')    # Sec 87A: new regime total income rebate threshold
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal('60000')        # Sec 87A: new regime max rebate

# First Schedule - Surcharge thresholds and rates (Old regime & New regime)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal('5000000'),    # First Schedule: 50 Lakhs threshold
    Decimal('10000000'),   # First Schedule: 1 Crore threshold
    Decimal('20000000'),   # First Schedule: 2 Crores threshold
    Decimal('50000000'),   # First Schedule: 5 Crores threshold (Old regime only)
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal('0'),          # Up to 50L
    Decimal('0.10'),       # > 50L up to 1Cr (10%)
    Decimal('0.15'),       # > 1Cr up to 2Cr (15%)
    Decimal('0.25'),       # > 2Cr up to 5Cr (25%)
    Decimal('0.37'),       # > 5Cr (37%)
]
SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal('0'),          # Up to 50L
    Decimal('0.10'),       # > 50L up to 1Cr (10%)
    Decimal('0.15'),       # > 1Cr up to 2Cr (15%)
    Decimal('0.25'),       # > 2Cr (Capped at 25% under Sec 115BAC)
    Decimal('0.25'),       # > 5Cr (Capped at 25% under Sec 115BAC)
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')  # Finance Act: 4% cess on tax plus surcharge

# Tax Slabs (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('400000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('400000'), Decimal('800000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('800000'), Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('2400000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('2400000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / Sec 288B rounding:
    First drop paise (floor to whole rupees using ROUND_FLOOR),
    then round to the nearest multiple of 10 where 5 or more rounds up.
    """
    whole_rupees = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    remainder = whole_rupees % Decimal('10')
    if remainder >= Decimal('5'):
        return whole_rupees + (Decimal('10') - remainder)
    else:
        return whole_rupees - remainder


def compute_tax_for_income(income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal('0')
    breakdown = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if income <= lower:
            break
        upper_bound = upper if upper is not None else income
        taxable_in_slab = min(income, upper_bound) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > 0:
            tax_in_slab = (taxable_in_slab * rate).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
            total_tax += tax_in_slab
            if upper is not None:
                desc = f"Tax at {rate*100}% on slab {lower+1:,} to {upper:,}"
            else:
                desc = f"Tax at {rate*100}% on slab above {lower:,}"
            breakdown.append((desc, tax_in_slab))
    return total_tax, breakdown


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp['gross_salary']))
    age = int(inp['age'])
    
    trace = []
    
    # 1. Salary income (Sec 17(1))
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })
    
    current_salary_income = gross_salary
    
    # 2. Standard Deduction (Sec 16(ia))
    std_ded_limit = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    std_ded = min(current_salary_income, std_ded_limit)
    if std_ded > 0:
        current_salary_income -= std_ded
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_ded),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
        })
        
    # 3. HRA Exemption (Sec 10(13A) / Rule 2A) - Old regime only
    if not is_new_regime:
        hra_received = Decimal(str(inp['hra_received']))
        basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp['basic_plus_da']))
        rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp['rent_paid']))
        is_metro = bool(inp['rent_city_is_metro'])
        
        if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
            excess_rent = rent_paid - (Decimal('0.10') * basic_plus_da)
            city_pct = Decimal('0.50') if is_metro else Decimal('0.40')
            city_limit = city_pct * basic_plus_da
            
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, max(Decimal('0'), excess_rent), city_limit)
            if hra_exempt > 0:
                current_salary_income -= hra_exempt
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "House rent allowance exemption",
                    "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                    "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
                })

    # 4. House Property Loss Set-off (Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A)) - Old regime only
    hp_loss = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp['home_loan_interest']))
        if home_loan_interest > 0:
            hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
            if hp_loss > 0:
                current_salary_income -= hp_loss
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                    "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                    "clause": "Sec 24(b)"
                })
                
    net_salary_income = max(Decimal('0'), current_salary_income)
    gross_total_income = net_salary_income
    
    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_deductions = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        # Sec 80C (capped at 1.5L)
        sec_80c = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80c'])), SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if sec_80c > 0:
            total_deductions += sec_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-sec_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })
            
        # Sec 80CCD(1B) (capped at 50k)
        sec_80ccd_1b = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80ccd_1b'])), SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if sec_80ccd_1b > 0:
            total_deductions += sec_80ccd_1b
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-sec_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })
            
        # Sec 80D
        health_self = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_self']))
        health_parents = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_parents']))
        parents_senior = bool(inp['parents_senior'])
        
        self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_BASE
        allowed_self = min(health_self, self_limit)
        
        parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_BASE
        allowed_parents = min(health_parents, parents_limit)
        
        sec_80d_total = allowed_self + allowed_parents
        if sec_80d_total > 0:
            total_deductions += sec_80d_total
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D",
                "amount": str(-sec_80d_total),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })
            
        # Sec 80A(2) overall cap: deductions cannot exceed Gross Total Income
        if total_deductions > gross_total_income:
            excess_deduction = total_deductions - gross_total_income
            # Reverse excess deduction trace items or adjust visually?
            # To keep trace amounts summing correctly to total_income, we cap deductions at GTI.
            # Let's re-calculate deduction components proportionally or simply cap total_deductions at GTI.
            # Standard practice: trim deductions cleanly.
            pass
            
    # Apply Sec 80A(2) cap precisely
    if total_deductions > gross_total_income:
        # Re-do deductions if they exceeded GTI
        # For simplicity and exact tracing, let's cap total deductions at GTI
        # If we need exact tracing, we can adjust the last deduction or scale.
        # Here, let's just make sure total deductions don't exceed gross total income.
        # But wait, to make income-kind amounts sum to total_income, let's compute total_income first.
        pass

    # Let's calculate deductions precisely respecting Sec 80A(2)
    allowed_chapter_via = min(total_deductions, gross_total_income)
    if total_deductions > gross_total_income and total_deductions > 0:
        # Adjust trace items for Chapter VI-A proportionately or replace with capped items
        # Let's filter/rebuild Chapter VI-A trace items so they sum exactly to -allowed_chapter_via
        scale = gross_total_income / total_deductions
        # Remove old VI-A trace items and add scaled ones
        trace = [t for t in trace if t["clause"] not in {"Sec 80C", "Sec 80CCD(1B)", "Sec 80D"}]
        
        if sec_80c > 0:
            val = (sec_80c * scale).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
            if val > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80C", "amount": str(-val), "clause": "Sec 80C"})
        if sec_80ccd_1b > 0:
            val = (sec_80ccd_1b * scale).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
            if val > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)", "amount": str(-val), "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"})
        if sec_80d_total > 0:
            val = (sec_80d_total * scale).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
            if val > 0:
                trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80D", "amount": str(-val), "clause": "Sec 80D"})
        total_deductions = allowed_chapter_via

    total_income_unrounded = max(Decimal('0'), gross_total_income - total_deductions)
    
    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
    income_rounding_adjustment = total_income - total_income_unrounded
    if income_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })
        
    # Select slabs
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60
            
    tax_before_rebate, slab_breakdown = compute_tax_for_income(total_income, slabs)
    for desc, slab_tax_amt in slab_breakdown:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(slab_tax_amt),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })
        
    current_tax = tax_before_rebate
    
    # Sec 87A Rebate
    rebate = Decimal('0')
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief (new regime only): where TI > 12L and tax exceeds (TI - 12L)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            if current_tax > excess_income:
                marginal_relief_rebate = current_tax - excess_income
                rebate = marginal_relief_rebate
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
            
    if rebate > 0:
        current_tax -= rebate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })
        
    # Surcharge
    surcharge_rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD
    applied_surcharge_rate = Decimal('0')
    applicable_threshold = None
    
    for threshold, rate in zip(SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS, surcharge_rates[1:]):
        if total_income > threshold:
            applied_surcharge_rate = rate
            applicable_threshold = threshold
            
    surcharge = (current_tax * applied_surcharge_rate).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {applied_surcharge_rate*100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })
        
    # Surcharge marginal relief
    if applicable_threshold is not None and surcharge > 0:
        # Tax + Surcharge on actual total income
        tax_plus_sur_actual = current_tax + surcharge
        
        # Tax on threshold income
        tax_at_threshold, _ = compute_tax_for_income(applicable_threshold, slabs)
        # Apply rebate at threshold if applicable (for old regime <= 5L, threshold is 50L so no rebate. For new regime, threshold is 50L > 12L so no rebate)
        
        # Surcharge at threshold at the LOWER rate that applies AT the threshold
        # Find rate at threshold
        rate_at_threshold = Decimal('0')
        for t, r in zip(SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS, surcharge_rates[1:]):
            if applicable_threshold > t: # wait, threshold IS t
                pass
        # Let's get exact index of applicable_threshold
        idx = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS.index(applicable_threshold)
        rate_at_threshold = surcharge_rates[idx] # lower rate applying at threshold
        
        surcharge_at_threshold = (tax_at_threshold * rate_at_threshold).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        tax_plus_sur_at_threshold = tax_at_threshold + surcharge_at_threshold
        
        max_tax_plus_sur = tax_plus_sur_at_threshold + (total_income - applicable_threshold)
        
        if tax_plus_sur_actual > max_tax_plus_sur:
            surcharge_relief = tax_plus_sur_actual - max_tax_plus_sur
            surcharge -= surcharge_relief
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
                "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                "clause": "First Schedule"
            })
            
    tax_after_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge
    
    # Health and Education Cess (4%)
    cess = (tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })
        
    tax_payable_unrounded = tax_after_surcharge + cess
    
    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax payable
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(tax_payable_unrounded)
    tax_rounding_adjustment = tax_payable - tax_payable_unrounded
    if tax_rounding_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })
        
    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
